messages:
noah.docs: Quick heads-up: I'm scheduling a 30m walkthrough to consolidate the Optimize Toolkit snippets (batching/caching/quant). Want to collapse duplicate examples into one toggled example and add a short migration note.

rita.eng: sounds good. when?

noah.docs: proposing tomorrow 10am PT. agenda: inventory, pick canonical snippets, identify runtime param mismatches, decide link canonicalization.

kai.opt: can we include a sample that demonstrates both sync + streaming in one file with a small toggle? e.g., `mode: streaming|sync` so devs can copy/paste.

noah.docs: yes exactly. my draft has a single example with `mode` toggles and a short table about perf tradeoffs.

alex.pm: please ensure the migration note calls out `microbatch_window_ms` and shows a simple mapping from old names to new ones. Also include a reminder to run the existing opt eval suite.

noah.docs: added mapping table in branch. sample mapping: `max_tokens_per_batch -> max_tokens_batch`, `prefetch_window_ms -> prefetch.window_ms`, plus note on `microbatch_window_ms`.

marie.qa: i'll run a smoke matrix on macOS and linux tomorrow: go/python/js, sync/streaming, kv-prefetch on/off. expect ~6h.

rita.eng: runtime change note: we added `microbatch_window_ms` only for Dedicated; hosted defaults still unchanged. worth a one-liner.

kai.opt: i'll add a short perf tip: "for short requests, prefer sync mode + small batch sizes; for steady throughput prefer streaming + batching".

noah.docs: added that phrasing. also inserted a tiny `kv-prefetch` snippet:
```yaml
prefetch:
  enabled: true
  window_ms: 50
  max_keys: 256
```

marie.qa: found a broken link in the draft -> `../optkit/batching.md` should point to `/docs/optimize/batching-examples.md`.

noah.docs: fixed link and pushed.

ci-bot: docs lint + linkcheck running for branch `opt/snippet-consolidation`

marie.qa: CI flagged a lint: sample_js.md had `client.stream()` not `client.streamChat()`. I pushed a tiny fix.

ci-bot: CI passed for branch `opt/snippet-consolidation`.

rita.eng: decision: consolidate three near-duplicate snippets into one toggled example. Create follow-up ticket OPT-4180 to split language variants if needed.

noah.docs: created OPT-4180 and linked it in the PR. also tagged owners: @optkit-samples @docs.

alex.pm: timeline: ship before Friday EOD. QA + reviews needed.

marie.qa: i'll mark ready for merge after smoke completes.

noah.docs: thanks all 60a will merge after QA signoff and then open a tiny follow-up to add embedding parity checks.
